verdict.rationale: The docs show the agent working autonomously across an app boundary: it leaves its own app, opens Clock, enters the time, ticks the days and saves. It runs in the background with Dynamic Island status, uses separate planner and actor models, and resumes from the same step if the board, hotspot or mirroring link drops. However, the only example crosses into a single other app, and there is no evidence that tasks chaining several apps complete reliably. missing for 10: a documented example of a task chaining three or more apps, task success-rate or reliability data, and independent or hands-on corroboration that runs finish without intervention.
